messages:
Sasha: Kicking off a targeted stress probe in us-west-2 at 11:30 PT to validate admission-control thresholds for GPU pools (p4d). Intent: saturate node pools enough to trigger queued requests and confirm graceful admission / rate-limit behavior. Can oncall watch infra dashboards? :eyes:

loadtest-bot: scheduled synthetic run 2026-03-18T18:30Z id=run-20260318-001 config=burst(1000rps,600s) target=api.v1.generate

Maria: oncall here, I'll tail the admission metrics and pod errors. Which pool and config are you using?

Sasha: pool=us-west-2-p4d-prod; policy=admission_v3 with queue_limit=500, reject_rate=0.05, slowpath_fallback=true

Sasha: config snippet:
```
clients: 200
burst: 1000
duration: 10m
target_routes:
  - /v1/generate
  - /v1/embeddings
headers:
  - x-rw-customer: test-load
```

Devon: FYI I tweaked the autoscaler cooldown to 45s before the run to avoid noisy scale-ups during test :thumbsup:

Maria: first wave looks red: queue_length -> 520 (above queue_limit), admission decisions shifting to 'queue' state; token_latency p95 spiking to 750ms. Screenshot: https://redwood.corp/grafana/shot/abc123

Sasha: noted. Are nodes saturated (GPU mem/util) or is it scheduling backlog?

Maria: GPU util across p4d nodes ~98%, mem high, but also kube-sched waiting pods due to pv attach timeouts in two AZs. Network errors increase for some pods (RSTs). Short log snippet:
```
E 2026-03-18T18:34:02Z admission-controller: queue full, enqueue-failures=3
W 2026-03-18T18:34:03Z node-exporter: tcp RST from 10.32.4.12: ephemeral
```

Devon: Interesting — looks like a mixed failure mode: capacity saturation + transient AZ network flakiness. The admission controller metrics show 12% rejects when queue > 800.

Maria: Can we lower queue_limit to 400 and bump reject_rate to 0.1 for next short probe? That should prevent large tail latencies.

Sasha: Agree for next probe. Action: roll admission_v3 -> admission_v3b with queue_limit=400 reject_rate=0.1; we'll run shorter 3m bursts to validate. Deployed to canary pool.

ops-oncall: Deploy check ok. Also filed infra ticket INF-2719 for PV attach spikes + netops notified.

Sasha: Thanks. Leaving this thread open, will post final metrics after 2nd run. :white_check_mark:
